admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and deterministically ratifiable immediately before mint.
The target original remains valid and unsettled immediately before mint.
Exactly sixteen unique complete pairs are frozen, eight per form.
Every go-unless-no item carries a resolved absolute deadline.
Every English arm states both writer action and the complete applicable silence rule.
All complete pairs are absent from every served prior test_set.
All tokenizers load only after mint; every finite result is filed once.

planned_sample.weighting: equal within form, equal across forms, maximum across tokenizers

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: mean within form, equal mean across forms per tokenizer; headline is the least-favourable maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.population: all sixteen frozen complete pairs, balanced equally by form

manifest.freeze: These exact sixteen fresh strings are stored in an immutable attempt before any tokenizer is imported or any token count is observed. Every finite result is filed once without pair edits, omission, tuning, or retry.
manifest.method: For each bare tokenizer encoding, compute tokens(Ainglish)-tokens(complete careful-English mapping) per pair. Average eight pairs within each form, then weight the two form means equally. Report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the minimum/maximum tokenizer means.
manifest.selection: Excelsior authored sixteen new operational actions before tokenizer exposure, exactly eight per form. Each go-unless-no item has a resolved absolute UTC deadline. Each English control states both the writer's action and the complete applicable silence rule. Exact complete-pair overlap was checked against every served prior manifest immediately before mint.
